# AbortSignal

[API index](../index.md)

Readonly cancellation signal for one host-controlled operation.

The host supplies an explicit reason and only the first abort wins. This subset has no public
controller, event API, or constructor.

**@keywords**

cancellation, abort, signal, reason, task

## aborted

```typescript
readonly aborted: boolean;
```

Whether the host has aborted this signal.

**@keywords**

cancellation, abort, signal, state

## reason

```typescript
readonly reason: unknown;
```

Original host-supplied abort reason, or `undefined` before cancellation.

**@keywords**

cancellation, abort, signal, reason, error

## throwIfAborted

```typescript
throwIfAborted(): void;
```

Throws the identical reason value when aborted and otherwise returns normally.

**@keywords**

cancellation, abort, signal, throw, checkpoint
